deck_name: 灵境导游_比赛产品方案PPT
goal: 在约 8–10 分钟内向比赛评审清晰呈现灵境导游的需求价值、完整方案、核心技术、创新差异、真实产品、测试证据与团队交付能力。

sample_generation_method.prompt_source: Codex conversation prompt approved on 2026-07-16 for slide 05
sample_generation_method.model_config: built-in preferred image model path; exact model setting not exposed

approved_style_reference.fidelity: match palette, typography mood, paper texture, ink illustration language and density only; do not copy the exact layout or content

style.name: 山水科技答辩风
style.visual_direction: formal Chinese innovation-competition defense deck combining restrained landscape-scroll aesthetics with modern information graphics; credible, cultured, evidence-led, calm and product-ready
style.color_palette: warm paper white #F7F1E6, ink blue #0B3A66, indigo teal #2F617A, very sparse cinnabar red #C84C35; avoid blue gradients and neon
style.typography: large dignified Chinese serif-like titles, clean readable Chinese sans-serif body, strong hierarchy, exact Chinese text, restrained English technical terms
style.texture_and_finish: subtle rice-paper fibers, very pale low-contrast mountain-and-water ink linework, crisp modern diagrams, thin ink-blue rules, sparse cinnabar seal-like emphasis
style.deck_consistency: keep the same palette, typography mood, paper texture, line-art icon language and cultural-tech balance across all slides; vary composition by semantic role
style.forbidden: cyberpunk, neon, glassmorphism, generic blue technology gradient, dense card walls, excessive decoration, invented logos, watermarks, slide numbers

deck_context.source_summary: 灵境导游面向智慧景区游客导览与运营管理，使用本地景区知识库、Qwen、多模态输入、Edge 中文语音、OpenTalking QuickTalk 与 WebRTC，提供实时问答、景点讲解、个性化推荐游线、数字人呈现和运营闭环。
deck_context.core_claim: 景区真正需要的不是会说话的海报，而是一套 7×24、基于本地资料、可持续运营、可降级且有证据边界的数字导游系统。
canonical_terms: A5—景区导览服务 AI 数字人
canonical_facts: 3 份本地资料、22 个景点、66 个可检索知识分片、113 条 FAQ
所有自测均非比赛官方评测
最新 WebRTC 报告为 720×720、25fps 目标档；会话创建到首个视频帧约 0.76s，音频到 speaking 约 0.19s，音频到可见口型运动约 2.93s
完整语音问答 30 次真实样本 P95<5s 仍待比赛机器现场实测
